title: Morgan Wallen’s 2027 Tour: Get Presale Tickets & Listen on SiriusXM
summary: Morgan Wallen announced his 2027 Last Time I Checked Tour and SiriusXM is celebrating with a special on Morgan Wallen Radio.
body_markdown:
Morgan Wallen has announced his 2027 *Last Time I Checked Tour* , featuring Brooks & Dunn, HARDY, Thomas Rhett, Cole Swindell, and Stella Lefty.


[Morgan Wallen Radio Curated by Morgan Wallen Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMorganWallenLastTimeICheckedTour)


To celebrate, SiriusXM listeners can tune in to a special on[Morgan Wallen Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/morgan-wallen-radio-siriusxm) on satellite channel 64 and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMorganWallenLastTimeICheckedTour) , featuring performances from Wallen’s intimate Nashville show, songs from the tour’s supporting artists and more.


The 7-city, 14-date stadium tour kicks off June 11, 2027, with two consecutive nights at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, FL. Wallen will play two nights in all locations, including stops at Columbus’ Ohio Stadium, Texas’ AT&T Stadium and more, before concluding in his home state at Tennessee’s Nissan Stadium on August 27 and 28. Full routing below.


Pre-sale registration is now open and through Thursday, November 19 at 10pm ET at[LastTimeICheckedTour.com](http://lasttimeicheckedtour.com/) . Tickets go on sale to the general public Friday, November 20, at 10am local time.


### Enter for a Chance to Win a Morgan Wallen VIP Concert Experience


Want to see Morgan Wallen live on his *Last Time I Checked Tour* ? SiriusXM is giving one lucky winner and guest the chance to experience the show with a VIP prize package!


**One grand prize winner will receive:**


- Roundtrip flights
- A two-night hotel stay
- Two *Last Time I Checked* VIP tickets to see Morgan Wallen on tour


**The *Last Time I Checked* VIP package includes:**


- Two pit tickets for the winner and a guest
- Access to the Official Morgan Wallen Preshow VIP Hospitality Lounge
- A Morgan Wallen-themed VIP cocktail upon arrival
- A special Morgan Wallen exhibit featuring archival photos, tour memorabilia, and more
- Two drink tokens good for beer, wine, or assorted soft drinks
- Complimentary appetizers, snacks, and desserts, plus access to a full cash bar
- VIP photo opportunities, including a photobooth, backdrops, props, and custom themes
- Priority check-in, a separate VIP entrance, and an on-site VIP team
- A dedicated fast lane for VIP merchandise shopping
- A Morgan Wallen VIP Tour Pack, including a commemorative VIP tour laminate and matching lanyard


**Enter from November 20 at 10am ET through December 20 at 11:59pm ET.**


[Enter for your chance to win a Morgan Wallen VIP concert experience.](https://www.siriusxm.com/Morganwallen2027)


Plus, Morgan Wallen’s Sand In My Boots Festival is returning to Gulf Shores, Alabama, May 21–23, 2027. Learn more about the[2027 Sand in My Boots Festival](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/morgan-wallen-sand-in-my-boots-lineup-2027) .

- **Saturday, July 17:** Athens, GA — Dooley Field at Sanford Stadium

- **Saturday, July 24:** Buffalo, NY — Highmark Stadium

- **Saturday, August 28:** Nashville, TN — Nissan Stadium

Hear the special on Morgan Wallen Radio (Ch. 64) at the following times ( **all ET** ):

For ticket information and presale registration, visit[lasttimeicheckedtour.com](https://lasttimeicheckedtour.com/) .
